With a deep champion pool, a calm personality and composed gameplays, He helped them win the third place in [[LDL/2019 Season/Summer Playoffs|LDL 2019 Summer Playoffs]]. ===2020 Season=== Owo continued to play in [[Suning-S]] throughout the shortened [[LDL/2020 Season/Spring Season|LDL 2020 Spring Season]]. He then was officially promoted to [[Suning]] at the beginning of Summer Season, but didn’t play one game for the team. Subsequently, he served as a substitute for them in the [[2020 Season World Championship]]. == Trivia == * Reached 3000 assists in the LPL on April 6, 2024. ** Was the 29th player to reach 3000 assists in the LPL. * Reached 4000 assists in the LPL on March 26, 2025. ** Was the 17th player to reach 4000 assists in the LPL. * Reached 5000 assists in the LPL on August 10, 2025. ** The 11th player to reach 5000 assists in the LPL. * Reached 6000 assists in the LPL on April 12, 2026. ** The 6th player to reach 6000 assists in the LPL. * Reached 300 wins in the LPL on May 31, 2025. ** Was the 24th player to reach 300 wins in the LPL. * Reached 500 games in the LPL on August 13, 2025. ** The 37th player to reach 500 games in the LPL. * Reached 1000 international assists during [[2025 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2025]] on July 06, 2025 in Upper Bracket Round 2 against [[T1]], becoming the 9th player to achieve this milestone after [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], Faker, [[xiaohu]], [[meiko]], [[Keria]], [[Caps]], [[Canyon]], and [[Oner]]. Reached it in the same game as Oner. {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} ===Individual Awards=== * LPL 1st All-Pro Team x4 (Summer 2023, Spring 2024, Split 2 2026, Split 3 2026) * LPL 2nd All Pro Team x3 (Summer 2024, Split 2 2025, Split 1 2026) * LPL 3rd All Pro Team x1 (Split 3 2025) == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerShowmatchResults|show=overviewpage}} {{PlayerResults1v1|show=overviewpage}} == Media == {{PlayerMedia}} ===Images=== {{PlayerProfileGallery}} {{PlayerPageEnd}}
